card.name: Possessive words before a noun
card.fires_on: The word "whose" (or a possessive stand-in such as "je", "SE" or a stray ? for an apostrophe) right after a person or group, where a noun owned by that person is expected next.

modes.label: Relative "whose"
modes.description: "whose" follows a named person or group and introduces something belonging to them.
modes.example: perhaps of the same family with the Toltecs,<< whose>> language they appear to have spoken.

modes.label: Garbled possessive mark
modes.description: A question mark stands where an apostrophe-s should be, before the owned noun.
modes.example: In addition, parents<<?>> primary reasons for homeschooling their children are

modes.label: Possessive-like pieces
modes.description: A split-off "SE" or Dutch "je" in a position where a possessive or object follows.
modes.example: SHOULD ONLY BE USED IN PATIENTS WHO<<SE>> EPILEPSY IS SO SEVER

card.writes: It favors words like "own" and "favorite" that come after a possessor, so the next word is an owned thing.
card.plain: It fires on "whose" and similar possessive spots, where the next word names something that belongs to the person just mentioned.
